items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and this other guy, Bill Sanford.

ctx.x: So Panama, we were talking about these great arrangers and especially the black ones that did such a job in contributing and really putting rock-and-roll and rhythm-and-blues on the map.
We didn't get to mention -- we were trying to remember Teacho Teshir Wilshire, a very precious man who did so very much.
Yeah, and this other guy, Bill Sanford.
